title: Research: exact parity constants and q-series for the projection recurrence
body:
PR #5193 leaves explicit q-series for the four projection modes and exact parity-sensitive leading error constants open. This adds a self-contained solution in `research/projection-parity-constants/`, with a proof, standard-library exact verifier, frozen receipt, source pins and independent AI review record.

For the unstrengthened recurrence with seed `a_4=(0,27456,48576,68320,86592)` and `T_m=a_m(m)/a_m(1)`, the result is

```text
T_m = 439277/149175
    + 2^(-m) [815083/596700 + (-1)^m (323/28) K]
    + O(4^(-m)),

K = product_{i>=1} ((1-2^(-i))/(1+2^(-i)))^2 > 0.
```

The even and odd limits of the scaled error are respectively `1.535225897075989125...` and `1.196743266657880490...`; the full scaled sequence has no limit. The proof derives an explicit convergent q-series for every fixed mode, applies classical q-Gauss summation, and subtracts the poles through +/-4 to justify the remainder. The rational limit is inherited from #5151; the four-mode reduction and sharp geometric order retain #5193's credit.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/projection-parity-constants
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/projection-parity-constants --check-source-history
```

Registered replay passed in normal and optimized, isolated, warning-strict Python, with identical outputs: 2,691 raw-recurrence/profile equalities, 276 finite-product identities, 520 eigenmode transformations, 32 generating-series enclosure comparisons, 16 residue checks and six rejected semantic perturbations. The committed-byte/source-history preflight passed for all eight package files; the GitHub publication tree `3222b7447ab0e7e1d5fe8ecc6a5b1e81fb440429` exactly matches that checked local tree. Finite checks corroborate the analytic argument; they are not a formal proof. Hosted CI remains separate.

`REVIEW.md` binds a separate Codex agent's mathematical/code review to exact hashes and records an independently written raw recurrence check through block 100. This is AI review, not human or proof-kernel verification.

## Scope, sources and credit

Publication base: canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority revision 7. The proof/review source snapshot is `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`; the relevant #5193 sources are unchanged. `TASK.json` explicitly declares the changed scope from the catalogue's `independent-moment` card to this user-selected arithmetic side result. Targeted projection PR searches and nearby source/handoff checks were performed; this is bounded overlap coverage, not a global novelty guarantee.

Prepared for Nicholas Stone / NicholasStone with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate AI review agent. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, supplier admission, physical caller, hook-rank certificate or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Open next questions are monotone-seed classification, further finite-coefficient simplification and the independent inherited physical/hook-rank obligations; concrete first steps and blockers are in `TASK.json`.

Merge scope: one isolated opt-in eight-file research package; no shared code or selected-result changes.
